title: Add SettingsRepository backed by DataStore Preferences
description: Plain constructor class (no DI framework) wrapping a preferencesDataStore, exposing a typed AppSettings data class via a Flow with defaults for every key, and a suspend setter. MVP scope is intentionally minimal: a single notificationsEnabled toggle.
acceptance_criteria: private val Context.dataStore: DataStore<Preferences> by preferencesDataStore(name = "med_timing_tracker_settings") declared at file scope
data class AppSettings(val notificationsEnabled: Boolean = true)
class SettingsRepository(private val context: Context) with a private object Keys containing a booleanPreferencesKey for notificationsEnabled
val settings: Flow<AppSettings> built from context.dataStore.data.map { prefs -> AppSettings(notificationsEnabled = prefs[Keys.NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED] ?: true) }
suspend fun setNotificationsEnabled(enabled: Boolean) writing via context.dataStore.edit { it[Keys.NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED] = enabled }
